audit_status.source_base: ChatGPT-authored Psalms completion draft using public-domain KJV as familiar alignment scaffold with curated Hebrew/textual overrides; full WLC/OSHB/source-witness audit pending
audit_status.review_note: Deliverance song, cosmic theophany, warfare, kingship, enemies, and the 2 Samuel 22 parallel.

verses.restored: I will love thee, O YHWH, my strength.

familiar.text: I will love thee, O LORD, my strength.

notes.title: Parallel song
notes.body: Psalm 18 has a close parallel in 2 Samuel 22. Differences between the two forms are textual evidence and should be preserved rather than harmonized.

modern.text: I love You, O LORD, my strength.

original.text: לַמְנַצֵּ֤חַ לְעֶ֥בֶד יְהוָ֗ה לְדָ֫וִ֥ד אֲשֶׁ֤ר דִּבֶּ֨ר לַיהוָ֗ה אֶת דִּ֭בְרֵי הַשִּׁירָ֣ה הַזֹּ֑את בְּי֤וֹם הִֽצִּיל יְהוָ֘ה אוֹת֥וֹ מִכַּ֥ף כָּל אֹ֝יְבָ֗יו וּמִיַּ֥ד שָׁאֽוּל וַיֹּאמַ֡ר אֶרְחָמְךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה חִזְקִֽי

verses.restored: YHWH is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.

familiar.text: The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.

modern.text: The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer. My God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.

original.text: יְהוָ֤ה סַֽלְעִ֥י וּמְצוּדָתִ֗י וּמְפַ֫לְטִ֥י אֵלִ֣י צ֭וּרִי אֶֽחֱסֶה בּ֑וֹ מָֽגִנִּ֥י וְקֶֽרֶן יִ֝שְׁעִ֗י מִשְׂגַּבִּֽי

verses.restored: I will call upon YHWH, who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.

familiar.text: I will call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.

modern.text: I will call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; so shall I be saved from my enemies.

original.text: מְ֭הֻלָּל אֶקְרָ֣א יְהוָ֑ה וּמִן אֹ֝יְבַ֗י אִוָּשֵֽׁעַ

verses.restored: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the floods of wicked men made me afraid.

familiar.text: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the floods of ungodly men made me afraid.

modern.text: The cords of death encompassed me; the torrents of chaos overwhelmed me.

original.text: אֲפָפ֥וּנִי חֶבְלֵי מָ֑וֶת וְֽנַחֲלֵ֖י בְלִיַּ֣עַל יְבַֽעֲתֽוּנִי

verses.restored: The cords of Sheol surrounded me; the snares of death confronted me.

familiar.text: The sorrows of hell compassed me about: the snares of death prevented me.

modern.text: The cords of Sheol entangled me; the snares of death confronted me.

original.text: חֶבְלֵ֣י שְׁא֣וֹל סְבָב֑וּנִי קִ֝דְּמ֗וּנִי מ֣וֹקְשֵׁי מָֽוֶת

verses.restored: In my distress I called upon YHWH, and cried unto my God: he heard my voice out of his temple, and my cry came before him, even into his ears.

familiar.text: In my distress I called upon the LORD, and cried unto my God: he heard my voice out of his temple, and my cry came before him, even into his ears.

modern.text: In my distress I called upon the LORD; I cried to my God for help. From His temple He heard my voice, and my cry for His help reached His ears.

original.text: בַּצַּר לִ֤י אֶֽקְרָ֣א יְהוָה֮ וְאֶל אֱלֹהַ֪י אֲשַׁ֫וֵּ֥עַ יִשְׁמַ֣ע מֵהֵיכָל֣וֹ קוֹלִ֑י וְ֝שַׁוְעָתִ֗י לְפָנָ֤יו תָּב֬וֹא בְאָזְנָֽיו

verses.restored: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations also of the hills moved and were shaken, because he was wroth.

familiar.text: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations also of the hills moved and were shaken, because he was wroth.

modern.text: Then the earth shook and quaked, and the foundations of the mountains trembled; they were shaken because He burned with anger.

original.text: וַתִּגְעַ֬שׁ וַתִּרְעַ֨שׁ הָאָ֗רֶץ וּמוֹסְדֵ֣י הָרִ֣ים יִרְגָּ֑זוּ וַ֝יִּתְגָּֽעֲשׁ֗וּ כִּי חָ֥רָה לֽוֹ

verses.restored: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.

familiar.text: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.

modern.text: Smoke rose from His nostrils, and consuming fire came from His mouth; glowing coals blazed forth.

original.text: עָ֘לָ֤ה עָשָׁ֨ן בְּאַפּ֗וֹ וְאֵשׁ מִפִּ֥יו תֹּאכֵ֑ל גֶּ֝חָלִ֗ים בָּעֲר֥וּ מִמֶּֽנּוּ

verses.restored: He bowed the heavens also, and came down: and darkness was under his feet.

familiar.text: He bowed the heavens also, and came down: and darkness was under his feet.

modern.text: He parted the heavens and came down with dark clouds beneath His feet.

original.text: וַיֵּ֣ט שָׁ֭מַיִם וַיֵּרַ֑ד וַ֝עֲרָפֶ֗ל תַּ֣חַת רַגְלָֽיו

verses.restored: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: yea, he did fly upon the wings of the wind.

familiar.text: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: yea, he did fly upon the wings of the wind.

modern.text: He mounted a cherub and flew; He soared on the wings of the wind.

original.text: וַיִּרְכַּ֣ב עַל כְּ֭רוּב וַיָּעֹ֑ף וַ֝יֵּ֗דֶא עַל כַּנְפֵי רֽוּחַ

verses.restored: He made darkness his secret place; his pavilion round about him were dark waters and thick clouds of the skies.

familiar.text: He made darkness his secret place; his pavilion round about him were dark waters and thick clouds of the skies.

modern.text: He made darkness His hiding place, and storm clouds a canopy around Him.

original.text: יָ֤שֶׁת חֹ֨שֶׁךְ סִתְר֗וֹ סְבִֽיבוֹתָ֥יו סֻכָּת֑וֹ חֶשְׁכַת מַ֝֗יִם עָבֵ֥י שְׁחָקִֽים

verses.restored: At the brightness that was before him his thick clouds passed, hail stones and coals of fire.

familiar.text: At the brightness that was before him his thick clouds passed, hail stones and coals of fire.

modern.text: From the brightness of His presence His clouds advanced— hailstones and coals of fire.

original.text: מִנֹּ֗גַהּ נֶ֫גְדּ֥וֹ עָבָ֥יו עָבְר֑וּ בָּ֝רָ֗ד וְגַֽחֲלֵי אֵֽשׁ

verses.restored: YHWH also thundered in the heavens, and the Highest gave his voice; hail stones and coals of fire.

familiar.text: The LORD also thundered in the heavens, and the Highest gave his voice; hail stones and coals of fire.

modern.text: The LORD thundered from heaven; the voice of the Most High resounded— hailstones and coals of fire.

original.text: וַיַּרְעֵ֬ם בַּשָּׁמַ֨יִם יְֽהוָ֗ה וְ֭עֶלְיוֹן יִתֵּ֣ן קֹל֑וֹ בָּ֝רָ֗ד וְגַֽחֲלֵי אֵֽשׁ

verses.restored: Yea, he sent out his arrows, and scattered them; and he shot out lightnings, and discomfited them.

familiar.text: Yea, he sent out his arrows, and scattered them; and he shot out lightnings, and discomfited them.

modern.text: He shot His arrows and scattered the foes; He hurled lightning and routed them.

original.text: וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח חִ֭צָּיו וַיְפִיצֵ֑ם וּבְרָקִ֥ים רָ֝ב וַיְהֻמֵּֽם

verses.restored: Then the channels of waters were seen, and the foundations of the world were discovered at thy rebuke, O YHWH, at the blast of the breath of thy nostrils.

familiar.text: Then the channels of waters were seen, and the foundations of the world were discovered at thy rebuke, O LORD, at the blast of the breath of thy nostrils.

modern.text: The channels of the sea appeared, and the foundations of the world were exposed, at Your rebuke, O LORD, at the blast of the breath of Your nostrils.

original.text: וַיֵּ֤רָא֨וּ אֲפִ֥יקֵי מַ֗יִם וַֽיִּגָּלוּ֮ מוֹסְד֪וֹת תֵּ֫בֵ֥ל מִגַּעֲרָ֣תְךָ֣ יְהוָ֑ה מִ֝נִּשְׁמַ֗ת ר֣וּחַ אַפֶּֽךָ

verses.restored: He sent from above, he took me, he drew me out of many waters.

familiar.text: He sent from above, he took me, he drew me out of many waters.

modern.text: He reached down from on high and took hold of me; He drew me out of deep waters.

original.text: יִשְׁלַ֣ח מִ֭מָּרוֹם יִקָּחֵ֑נִי יַֽ֝מְשֵׁ֗נִי מִמַּ֥יִם רַבִּֽים

verses.restored: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them which hated me: for they were too strong for me.

familiar.text: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them which hated me: for they were too strong for me.

modern.text: He rescued me from my powerful enemy, from foes too mighty for me.

original.text: יַצִּילֵ֗נִי מֵאֹיְבִ֥י עָ֑ז וּ֝מִשֹּׂנְאַ֗י כִּֽי אָמְצ֥וּ מִמֶּֽנִּי

verses.restored: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but YHWH was my stay.

familiar.text: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the LORD was my stay.

modern.text: They confronted me in my day of calamity, but the LORD was my support.

original.text: יְקַדְּמ֥וּנִי בְיוֹם אֵידִ֑י וַֽיְהִי יְהוָ֖ה לְמִשְׁעָ֣ן לִֽי

verses.restored: He brought me forth also into a large place; he delivered me, because he delighted in me.

familiar.text: He brought me forth also into a large place; he delivered me, because he delighted in me.

modern.text: He brought me out into the open; He rescued me because He delighted in me.

original.text: וַיּוֹצִיאֵ֥נִי לַמֶּרְחָ֑ב יְ֝חַלְּצֵ֗נִי כִּ֘י חָ֥פֵֽץ בִּֽי

verses.restored: YHWH rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.

familiar.text: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.

modern.text: The LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness; He has repaid me according to the cleanness of my hands.

original.text: יִגְמְלֵ֣נִי יְהוָ֣ה כְּצִדְקִ֑י כְּבֹ֥ר יָ֝דַ֗י יָשִׁ֥יב לִֽי

verses.restored: For I have kept the ways of YHWH, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

familiar.text: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

modern.text: For I have kept the ways of the LORD and have not wickedly departed from my God.

original.text: כִּֽי שָׁ֭מַרְתִּי דַּרְכֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְלֹֽא רָ֝שַׁ֗עְתִּי מֵאֱלֹהָֽי

verses.restored: For all his judgments were before me, and I did not put away his statutes from me.

familiar.text: For all his judgments were before me, and I did not put away his statutes from me.

modern.text: For all His ordinances are before me; I have not disregarded His statutes.

original.text: כִּ֣י כָל מִשְׁפָּטָ֣יו לְנֶגְדִּ֑י וְ֝חֻקֹּתָ֗יו לֹא אָסִ֥יר מֶֽנִּי

verses.restored: I was also upright before him, and I kept myself from mine iniquity.

familiar.text: I was also upright before him, and I kept myself from mine iniquity.

modern.text: And I have been blameless before Him and kept myself from iniquity.

original.text: וָאֱהִ֣י תָמִ֣ים עִמּ֑וֹ וָ֝אֶשְׁתַּמֵּ֗ר מֵעֲוֺנִֽי

verses.restored: Therefore hath YHWH recompensed me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.

familiar.text: Therefore hath the LORD recompensed me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.

modern.text: So the LORD has repaid me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in His sight.

original.text: וַיָּֽשֶׁב יְהוָ֣ה לִ֣י כְצִדְקִ֑י כְּבֹ֥ר יָ֝דַ֗י לְנֶ֣גֶד עֵינָֽיו

verses.restored: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful; with an upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright;

familiar.text: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful; with an upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright;

modern.text: To the faithful You show Yourself faithful, to the blameless You show Yourself blameless;

original.text: עִם חָסִ֥יד תִּתְחַסָּ֑ד עִם גְּבַ֥ר תָּ֝מִ֗ים תִּתַּמָּֽם

verses.restored: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself froward.

familiar.text: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself froward.

modern.text: to the pure You show Yourself pure, but to the crooked You show Yourself shrewd.

original.text: עִם נָבָ֥ר תִּתְבָּרָ֑ר וְעִם עִ֝קֵּ֗שׁ תִּתְפַּתָּֽל

verses.restored: For thou wilt save the afflicted people; but wilt bring down high looks.

familiar.text: For thou wilt save the afflicted people; but wilt bring down high looks.

modern.text: For You save an afflicted people, but You humble those with haughty eyes.

original.text: כִּֽי אַ֭תָּה עַם עָנִ֣י תוֹשִׁ֑יעַ וְעֵינַ֖יִם רָמ֣וֹת תַּשְׁפִּֽיל

verses.restored: For thou wilt light my candle: YHWH my God will enlighten my darkness.

familiar.text: For thou wilt light my candle: the LORD my God will enlighten my darkness.

modern.text: For You, O LORD, light my lamp; my God lights up my darkness.

original.text: כִּֽי אַ֭תָּה תָּאִ֣יר נֵרִ֑י יְהוָ֥ה אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י יַגִּ֥יהַּ חָשְׁכִּֽי

verses.restored: For by thee I have run through a troop; and by my God have I leaped over a wall.

familiar.text: For by thee I have run through a troop; and by my God have I leaped over a wall.

modern.text: For in You I can charge an army, and with my God I can scale a wall.

original.text: כִּֽי בְ֭ךָ אָרֻ֣ץ גְּד֑וּד וּ֝בֵֽאלֹהַ֗י אֲדַלֶּג שֽׁוּר

verses.restored: As for God, his way is perfect: the word of YHWH is tried: he is a shield to all those that trust in him.

familiar.text: As for God, his way is perfect: the word of the LORD is tried: he is a buckler to all those that trust in him.

modern.text: As for God, His way is perfect; the word of the LORD is flawless. He is a shield to all who take refuge in Him.

original.text: הָאֵל֮ תָּמִ֪ים דַּ֫רְכּ֥וֹ אִמְרַֽת יְהוָ֥ה צְרוּפָ֑ה מָגֵ֥ן ה֝֗וּא לְכֹ֤ל הַחֹסִ֬ים בּֽוֹ

verses.restored: For who is God save YHWH? or who is a rock save our God?

familiar.text: For who is God save the LORD? or who is a rock save our God?

modern.text: For who is God besides the LORD? And who is the Rock except our God?

original.text: כִּ֤י מִ֣י אֱ֭לוֹהַּ מִבַּלְעֲדֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וּמִ֥י צ֝֗וּר זוּלָתִ֥י אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ

verses.restored: It is God that girdeth me with strength, and maketh my way perfect.

familiar.text: It is God that girdeth me with strength, and maketh my way perfect.

modern.text: It is God who arms me with strength and makes my way clear.

original.text: הָ֭אֵל הַמְאַזְּרֵ֣נִי חָ֑יִל וַיִּתֵּ֖ן תָּמִ֣ים דַּרְכִּֽי

verses.restored: He makes my feet like the feet of a deer and sets me securely on my heights.

familiar.text: He maketh my feet like hinds’ feet, and setteth me upon my high places.

modern.text: He makes my feet like those of a deer and stations me upon the heights.

original.text: מְשַׁוֶּ֣ה רַ֭גְלַי כָּאַיָּל֑וֹת וְעַ֥ל בָּ֝מֹתַ֗י יַעֲמִידֵֽנִי

verses.restored: He teacheth my hands to war, so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.

familiar.text: He teacheth my hands to war, so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.

modern.text: He trains my hands for battle; my arms can bend a bow of bronze.

original.text: מְלַמֵּ֣ד יָ֭דַי לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה וְֽנִחֲתָ֥ה קֶֽשֶׁת נְ֝חוּשָׁ֗ה זְרוֹעֹתָֽי

verses.restored: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy right hand hath holden me up, and thy gentleness hath made me great.

familiar.text: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy right hand hath holden me up, and thy gentleness hath made me great.

modern.text: You have given me Your shield of salvation; Your right hand upholds me, and Your gentleness exalts me.

original.text: וַתִּתֶּן לִי֮ מָגֵ֪ן יִ֫שְׁעֶ֥ךָ וִֽימִינְךָ֥ תִסְעָדֵ֑נִי וְֽעַנְוַתְךָ֥ תַרְבֵּֽנִי

verses.restored: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, that my feet did not slip.

familiar.text: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, that my feet did not slip.

modern.text: You broaden the path beneath me so that my ankles do not give way.

original.text: תַּרְחִ֣יב צַעֲדִ֣י תַחְתָּ֑י וְלֹ֥א מָ֝עֲד֗וּ קַרְסֻלָּֽי

verses.restored: I have pursued mine enemies, and overtaken them: neither did I turn again till they were consumed.

familiar.text: I have pursued mine enemies, and overtaken them: neither did I turn again till they were consumed.

modern.text: I pursued my enemies and overtook them; I did not turn back until they were consumed.

original.text: אֶרְדּ֣וֹף א֭וֹיְבַי וְאַשִּׂיגֵ֑ם וְלֹֽא אָ֝שׁוּב עַד כַּלּוֹתָֽם

verses.restored: I have wounded them that they were not able to rise: they are fallen under my feet.

familiar.text: I have wounded them that they were not able to rise: they are fallen under my feet.

modern.text: I crushed them so they could not rise; they have fallen under my feet.

original.text: אֶ֭מְחָצֵם וְלֹא יֻ֣כְלוּ ק֑וּם יִ֝פְּל֗וּ תַּ֣חַת רַגְלָֽי

verses.restored: For thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle: thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me.

familiar.text: For thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle: thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me.

modern.text: You have armed me with strength for battle; You have subdued my foes beneath me.

original.text: וַתְּאַזְּרֵ֣נִי חַ֭יִל לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה תַּכְרִ֖יעַ קָמַ֣י תַּחְתָּֽי

verses.restored: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies; that I might destroy them that hate me.

familiar.text: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies; that I might destroy them that hate me.
